author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
Same root cause as #981: the emulator wasn't zeroing PolicyEngine's **imputed Medicare Part B premiums**, whose federal medical deduction lowered OH AGI below the zero-bracket, so PE returned $0 OH tax (the $4,800 exemption was applied correctly all along). TAXSIM/TaxAct have no medical input.

Fixed in #993 by zeroing `medical_expense_health_insurance_premiums` in the emulator. After the fix OH tax is **$330.83**, matching the NBER `taxsimtest` binary to the penny. Closing as resolved by #993.
